acceptance_checks: The Enforce MergeGate step's MERGED_PRS resolution is not nested inside a post_merge_reconcile marker test.
MERGED_PRS is resolved from the BASE snapshot's task expected_pr, never the head's, and only when that PR's state is MERGED.
post_merge_reconcile PRs receive the same --merged-prs value as before.

Both mergegate_check.py and guardian_approval_signal.py invocations in this workflow receive --base-shiki and --merged-prs, asserted by an enumeration test that fails if a future invocation omits them.
tests/test_policy_job_merged_prs.py exists and covers all of the above.
bash scripts/test_shiki_workflow_lint.sh and bash scripts/test_shiki_governance_evidence.sh stay green without being modified.
No file outside the declared locks is changed.
non_goals: Changing the six ADR 0017 conditions or the classifier
Resolving the implementation PR from the HEAD task's expected_pr
Making either gate more permissive than the other
scope:
In `.github/workflows/shiki-cca-completion.yml`, move the `MERGED_PRS` resolution in the `Enforce MergeGate` step out of the `post_merge_reconcile`-marker conditional so it is computed for every PR the job judges. Resolve it the same way the Prepare CCA context step already does for the CCA signal: take the task id from the PR body with the same TASK_ID semantics `mergegate_check.py` uses, read `expected_pr` from the BASE snapshot task file (`.shiki/gha/base-shiki/.shiki/tasks/<task_id>.json` — the base value, never the head's, which the PR can write), and include that number in `MERGED_PRS` only when `gh pr view` reports its state MERGED.

The post_merge_reconcile path must keep receiving exactly the value it receives today; that mode consumes the same `--merged-prs` input to prove its referenced PR merged, so its behaviour must not change. Computing the value for other modes as well is additive.

Add `tests/test_policy_job_merged_prs.py` asserting the workflow's shape: the `Enforce MergeGate` step's `MERGED_PRS` resolution is not nested inside a `post_merge_reconcile` marker test; it reads the base snapshot's task file rather than the head's; and it gates inclusion on a MERGED state. Add a wiring-completeness assertion that enumerates the invocations of `mergegate_check.py` and `guardian_approval_signal.py` in this workflow and requires each to receive `--base-shiki` and `--merged-prs`, so a future invocation added without them fails the suite instead of silently reintroducing this gap.

REPRODUCIBILITY — what this task removes, and what to change to get the same result.
  Symptom: a closeout PR for a high/critical task shows `CCA verdict` PASS with `.shiki/gha/guardian-approval.json` reporting `required: false, bookkeeping_closeout_exemption: true`, and `MergeGate policy check` FAIL with `Guardian label 'guardian:approved' is missing`. One gate exempts the PR and the other does not, so the ADR 0017 exemption still cannot produce a merge without an operator approval.
  Root cause: the policy job passes `--base-shiki` but computes `MERGED_PRS` only inside `if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q '<!-- shiki:post_merge_reconcile -->'`. A bookkeeping closeout carries no such marker, so `MERGED_PRS` is empty and ADR 0017 condition 6 cannot be established. The classifier then fails closed — correct behaviour on an input the job never supplied.
  Exact change that reproduces this result: hoist the `MERGED_PRS` resolution out of the marker conditional so it runs for every judged PR, reading `expected_pr` from the BASE task snapshot and including it only when that PR is MERGED.
  Manual step removed: one Guardian approval per closeout of a high/critical task — the last remaining piece of the cost ADR 0017 was written to remove.
  Observed: PR #212 (head 39da367baaab745d0e6c100fa4b53b5d6699b7ff) and PR #213 (head 4be8fb7341520aaf9d3b8f577b0d24a66a7f28da), both closeouts of critical tasks: CCA signal exempt, policy check blocked, each merged only after a manual approval.
  Reproducible when: `shiki loop step` drives a critical task's closeout from creation to merge with zero Guardian approvals, and every ADR 0017 disqualifier still blocks on BOTH gates.
test_command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && bash scripts/test_shiki_workflow_lint.sh && bash scripts/test_shiki_governance_evidence.sh && python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py --target .
title: Resolve the merged-PR proof for every PR the policy job judges, not only post_merge_reconcile
